title: Collection Rate of Bloobox for Recycling Campaign
what_it_is: Collection Rate of Bloobox for Recycling Campaign

sections.label: Bloobox distribution by 30 April 2023
sections.summary: By the end of the distribution period on 30 April 2023, about 530,000 or 93% of the Blooboxes had been distributed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: By the end of the distribution period on 30 April 2023, about 530,000 or 93% of the Blooboxes have been distributed.

sections.label: Not every household needs Bloobox
sections.summary: Not every household requires a Bloobox as many may already have existing recycling corners using other containers, which was considered when planning the number to be distributed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Nevertheless, not every household requires a Bloobox as many may already have existing recycling corners using other containers, and this was taken into consideration when we planned for the number of Blooboxes to be distributed in this initiative.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The remaining Blooboxes will be used to support this campaign.

sections.label: Bloobox programme cost and collection
sections.summary: The cost of the Bloobox campaign is not held, and 93% of the estimated Blooboxes were collected, with the remaining used to promote recycling.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: I am wondering if you would be willing to share the total cost of the Bloobox programme and, after you have finally collected the data on recycling, whether there is a certain threshold percentage for which we would regard this programme as cost effective.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: I do not have the cost of the Bloobox campaign.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my reply, we had estimated the number of Blooboxes required.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We did not produce or procure Blooboxes to cover all households in Singapore because that would not be realistic and we know that not every household would require it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We were quite close to our estimate – 93% of the Blooboxes were collected.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The remaining will not be put to waste because they will be used in our efforts to promote recycling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Most importantly, with 93% collected, there are these households who have interest in the Bloobox and we hope that they would put the Blooboxes to good use.
